sources.claim: MITRE ATT&CK says IcedID has been downloaded by Emotet in multiple campaigns.
MITRE ATT&CK says Emotet is primarily used as a downloader for malware variants such as TrickBot and IcedID.

curator_note: Modeled from the payload perspective: IcedID is loaded by Emotet.
confidence_reason: Direct statements in ATT&CK from both family pages.
